title: Contract-First Epistemology: Semester I — Method Internalization (Weeks 1–14)
object_of_study: Making judgment evaluable: bounding evaluative objects, freezing contracts, preserving missingness, and completing a first auditable mini-pass.
main_question: What must be declared before judgment becomes evaluable?

claim_layers.claim: Governing Semester Question: What must be declared before judgment becomes evaluable? (source-stated).

Instructional burden: make judgment evaluable before students handle return, ledger reconciliation, diagnostics, domain transfer, critique, or final casepack defense; Weeks 1–14 begin with ordinary judgment and end with the first complete mini-pass (May 6, 2026, Course Architecture v1.0).

The course architecture is structurally declared (source-stated); classroom efficacy is a separate, not-yet-evaluable claim that the source itself says should not be asserted as proven until it returns through actual instruction, student artifacts, assessment records, and repair evidence.
The library registers Semester I as a distinct teaching witness within the course line, not as a copy of the full course.
